description.value:
Holding two or more Twin-Linked guns, fire them together at one target as a single attack: same firing mode, all explosive or none. Use the highest DV and your lowest Skill among them; each spends its normal ammo. On a hit, roll the biggest gun's damage (highest Autofire rating on Autofire) and add +1 for each d6 the others would have rolled. A Heavy Pistol and an Assault Rifle at 12m: the rifle's DV16, then 5d6+3.

Cost: 500eb
Fits: All Smartgun Link and Smart Rebuild Attachments
